name: Contract Registration Statement Request V 04
definition: The ContractRegistrationStatementRequest message is sent by the reporting party to the registration agent to request for a statement of the operations related to the registered contract subject to currency control.

GroupHeader.name: Group Header
GroupHeader.definition: Characteristics shared by all individual items included in the message.

StatementRequest.name: Statement Request
StatementRequest.definition: Details on the information requested for the contract registration statement.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
